candidate.user_input: When does a Navan hotel stay require an expense report for business incidentals?
candidate.reference: A Navan hotel stay does not require an expense report if you do not incur any additional hotel charges. However, incidental expenses that are business-related and within policy still are required to be submitted through an expense report.

evidence.quote: If you do not incur any additional hotel charges, there will be no need to submit an expense report for your stay.
evidence.contribution: Clarifies when an expense report is not needed.

evidence.quote: Incidental expenses that are business-related and within policy still are required to be submitted through an expense report.
evidence.contribution: Specifies that business-related incidentals require an expense report.

candidate.connection: The evidence clarifies the conditions under which an expense report is required for hotel stays booked through Navan.
